title: Death Magnetic Retail vs Guitar Hero 3
summary: A short comparison of the retail release of Metallica's Death Magnetic against the Guitar Hero 3 version of the same song. It switches between the two so you can hear and see the heavy clipping in the retail master.
why: HN uses it as the go-to demonstration of the loudness war and what over-compressed mastering does to music.

quote.text: A comparison between these two versions was the eye opener for me.
